correctness.rationale: The semigroup rule (i,j)(h,l)=(i,l) gives ab=rho(a)gamma(b)^T. For nonzero rank-one R=a⊗f, RB identity forces a²=λa and fL_a=μf, fR_a=νf, μ+ν=λ. If λ=0, μ=ν=0; a²=0 iff row or column marginal vanishes. The row/column marginal map has fibers of dimension (m-1)(n-1); disjoint possibilities (u=v=0), (u=0,v!=0), (v=0,u!=0) yield the three terms divided by q-1. When λ!=0, a=α^{-1}uv^T with α=τ(a)!=0; the scaled left/right operators are commuting projections with ranks n,m and one-dimensional intersection. Their (1,0) and (0,1) dual eigenspaces have dimensions n-1,m-1 and yield q^{m+n-2}(q^{n-1}+q^{m-1}-2). Distinct pair representations divide by q-1; all characteristics and m=1/n=1 boundaries work. Independent finite sums agree with B_{1,2}(3)=8, B_{2,2}(2)=35, B_{2,2}(3)=164, B_{2,3}(2)=429. The algebraic classification, not finite cases, supports arbitrary q.
